description: The Mac window pages that the bundled engine serves on 127.0.0.1 may call Writer's own shell commands (report the window title and menu state, open or close the settings / about / gestures windows, open a tab dragged off the title strip in a window of its own, zoom on a title-strip double-click, keep the shared settings, show the Save and open dialogs, list and open recent files, restart after a language change, ask about and set the default app, check for updates, hand a PDF to another viewer) and drive their own window from the design's traffic lights (close, minimize, full screen, zoom). Nothing else: no file system, shell or other windows.
